description.value:
The patron god of dwarves, Torag, vanished along with Golarion during the Gap, leaving his younger brother Angradd to assume guardianship of the dwarven people. Aggressive and militaristic, Angradd exhorts the dual importance of upholding traditions and fighting to preserve them.

Title The Forge-Fire

Areas of Concern fire, tradition, war

Edicts seek and destroy evil, study evil to learn the best way to destroy it, train others in righteous ways, preserve dwarven traditions

Anathema Allow weaker evils to survive due to the presence of larger evils, deceive others outside of tactical gain

publication.title: Beyond the Blood Door Player's Guide
